principle: Recognise the setup WHILE it develops, state what is still missing, and never confuse the reference traders' leverage-driven money results with directional edge. The engine measures structure; the model judges it.

V_RECOVERY_FAILURE.story: A sharp leg (the 'flush') leaves an origin. Price snaps back fast - a V - into that origin zone or the broken shelf. The first sign that the recovery cannot accept there is the entry; the leg low / imbalance is the target.
approach: leg of at least ~3 M3 ATR inside about 12 M3 bars
recovery of >=55% of the leg, reached quickly (a 'V', often one or two large candles)
recovery high at or just under the leg origin, drawn as a box/zone by the traders
readiness: the bar that printed the recovery high is closed and price is >=0.3 ATR off it
failure evidence: a pin/upper wick on the high bar, a close below its midpoint, or an M1 close below the previous M1 low
still close to the high (traders entered 0.9-2.4 points below it)
V_RECOVERY_FAILURE.early: V7 trader sold IN the zone before any bearish displacement (first fill red -67). Early = small risk, frequent heat.
V_RECOVERY_FAILURE.late: price already >1.5 ATR below the recovery high, or the leg low is near (V6: room to the prior low was small and the campaign stalled there).
contradictions: recovery closes and holds above the origin (acceptance) -> this becomes a breakout
higher lows keep forming under the zone (V8 is that opposite story)
the 2-hour structure is a strong trend in the recovery's direction
falseConfirmations: a single M1 red candle inside a still-rising M3
a wick with no follow-through while lows keep rising
V_RECOVERY_FAILURE.invalidation: above the recovery high (+0.2 ATR); thesis is dead if price accepts above the origin
V_RECOVERY_FAILURE.targets: imbalance/FVG left by the recovery candle first, then the leg low ('liquidity below the previous lows')

SPIKE_REJECTION.story: A near-vertical impulse runs into a NEW local extreme (beyond the last ~20 M3 bars) and cannot hold it. The vertical leg leaves a fair-value gap that the trader expects to be filled.
approach: impulse of >=2.2 M3 ATR inside 3 M3 bars
new high/low versus the prior hour
often a news/tick burst (V9 11:27: 782 ticks in a minute)
readiness: pin bar on the extreme or the next M1 closing in its lower half / below the prior low
SPIKE_REJECTION.early: V3 sold inside the forming spike candle ~3 points under its high.
SPIKE_REJECTION.late: price already back at the impulse origin; the FVG is mostly filled.
contradictions: the spike candle closes near its high and the next bar extends
a retest of the extreme holds and breaks again
falseConfirmations: first pullback after a breakout of a long range (continuation is common)
SPIKE_REJECTION.targets: the FVG of the impulse, then the impulse origin

BREAK_PAUSE_CONTINUATION.story: Structure breaks with a displacement candle through a shelf of prior lows. The counter-move is weak: small bodies with rejection wicks that cannot reclaim the shelf. Entry on the break of the pause.
approach: M3 close beyond the lowest low of the prior 6 bars with a >=0.6 ATR body
descending context (older highs above the shelf)
readiness: 1-5 small pause candles under the broken shelf, at least one with a rejection wick
latest M1 closes through the pause low; not more than 0.8 ATR beyond it
BREAK_PAUSE_CONTINUATION.early: V1 entry was at the pause low itself; the engine marked it 5 minutes earlier.
BREAK_PAUSE_CONTINUATION.late: price far below the pause low or after several pause/break cycles.
contradictions: a pause candle closes back above the broken shelf
the break candle is fully retraced
falseConfirmations: a break from a tight range without displacement
BREAK_PAUSE_CONTINUATION.targets: measured continuation; the trader held for an equity target

RECOVERY_CONTINUATION.story: After a flush, price builds higher lows back toward the origin of the flush; the origin box / imbalance above is the magnet. Single-example family: low evidential weight.
approach: flush of >=3 ATR within ~15 M1 bars
two or more successive higher M1 swing lows
at least 35% of the leg still left to the origin
readiness: M1 closes above the recent micro range
contradictions: a lower low below the recovery base
RECOVERY_CONTINUATION.targets: the origin box (V8 closed on the spike into it)

observed: first entry often red for seconds to a minute
adds while the BASKET is green, frequently in same-price bursts, sometimes above the previous fill
size only grows when floating equity funds it
exit by equity target or bulk close
failureModes: large late adds at the extended low / prior low (V4, V7 10 lots, V9 20 lots)
adding after a pullback has already weakened control
campaign.apexRules: Apex keeps its own sizing, protections and duplicate-order rules. The model may HOLD / STOP_ADDING / EXIT / ADD only with fresh same-direction evidence.

measuredReality: See base-rates.json: on 2021-2026 M1 data the mechanically detected shapes are not better than random entries after spread on the held-out period. Treat a recognised family as a hypothesis that needs the specific confirming behaviour, not as an edge.
